Replaces the MemoryStream backing record and capacity, preserving a capacity-bounded byte prefix when both old and new backing exist.
ECX is the stream and the one stack DWORD is requestedCapacity; RET4. Nonzero capacity allocates a0x14 backing object through004E0A20 and payload through004DEF60; null record/data returns false AL, with constructed-null-data backing released through004DEE00. These false exits have no explicit replacement store to stream+4/+14, but called allocation/release side effects remain open; no global rollback/OOM guarantee. Copy count is unsigned min(requestedCapacity, oldCapacity), not logical length. Old signed count+C>1 is decremented; otherwise byte+10 gates data allocator+0C and record virtual0(flag1). Success stores stream+4/+14 and AL1; zero request releases/clears backing and capacity. Logical length+10, position+18 and growth permission+1C are not changed or checked here. Only AL is the success contract; upper EAX bits are path-dependent residues. Preserve the current undefined4 nativeSignature/thiscall/types although C renders uint; valid backing/allocator storage and lifetime are prerequisites.

Drops a reference to the MemoryStream backing record, or dispatches its final payload/record release path.
ECX supplies the backing record and the body uses plain RET. If signed count+C>1, decrement that DWORD and return its new value in EAX. Otherwise byte+10 gates allocator+0C(data+8,0), then call record virtual0(flag1) and return EAX0, without first decrementing count. Zero is not a general Boolean success or proof of deallocation/liveness. This body has no null-record guard, LOCK instruction or lifetime validation. The selected constructor/prefix/default-adapter release chain is a separate dependency; foreign allocator/object callbacks and alias ownership remain open. Preserve int fastcall return/parameter projections and original bytes.

Releases an allocator chunk through conditional bin/coalescing or region-dispatch paths; this is not a universal OS-free or successful-deallocation guarantee.
ECX is the allocator, the one raw stack DWORD is the payload address, RET4. Null skips metadata updates. Nonnull reads headers at payload-10h/-0Ch and requires valid chunk/list state. Masked span<=allocator+4 enters a size bin; larger mask02-clear chunks coalesce/list-update and may call004E5080/004E54E0 for trimming. Mask02-set regions unlink and decrement allocator+48Ch/+488h accounting before KERNEL32!VirtualFree(base,0,8000h), whose result is not checked or rolled back here. Different paths leave unrelated EAX residues, with no normalized success result. Shared wrapper004E5E70 conditionally brackets this body with allocator locking; no global thread/ownership/liveness/OOM/rollback contract follows. Preserve current undefined nativeSignature/thiscall and int address-word parameter although C renders void and pointer casts; no type/ABI/boundary edit.
